texts.facts: It is submitted that since Ext.P5 order was issued by the 4th respondent in the background of report to the effect that the contaminated water from abandoned quarries are being used without treatment for drinking purposes and that the complete ban imposed by Ext.P6 is not sustainable.
texts.arguments: 3. The learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that the petitioners are using the water from the quarry in question only for industrial purposes and Ext.P6 is a complete ban imposed for usage of water from the quarry for any purposes.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 3. The learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that the petitioners are using the water from the quarry in question only for industrial purposes and Ext.P6 is a complete ban imposed for usage of water from the quarry for any purposes.
